assertions.name: T3_equals_T8_symbolically
assertions.source: T3 = ℏ_q³ · [2]_q / 4 and T8 = ℏ_q³ · (q+q⁻¹) / 4 are identical Laurent polynomials in q because [2]_q ≡ q + q⁻¹.  Sympy.simplify of the difference equals 0.  Confirms the audit doc's 4-candidate bracket is structurally a 3-candidate bracket.

description: Symbolic comparison of the 3 distinct rung-2 candidates in the c_3 closure bracket. Verifies T3 = T8 algebraically, compares T1/T3/T7 by structural cleanliness (T7 alone has a q-integer denominator), lists 3 candidate categorical sources for the structural lift. Does NOT prove lift.

structural_lift_hypotheses: Hyp-A: T7 = (3-strand Markov-trace at identity) / dim_q(V_1) = (3-strand component) / [2]_q
Hyp-B: T7 = Wenzl projector p_3 contribution at order h^3 / Temperley-Lieb loop value [2]_q
Hyp-C: T7 = (Kauffman bracket order-h^3 coefficient) / (unknot Kauffman bracket in [2]_q normalization)
data.status: All 3 hypotheses unproven; c_3 remains NEAR-MATCH (2.65 ppm)
